title: Watch Value Concentration by Brand
dataSources: Discogs collection entries (`discogs:item`), comics (`comic:item`), coin catalogue entries (`coin:item`), stamp album entries (`stamp:item`), and watch logs (`watch:item`).
app: Collection telemetry from Discogs, Comic Vine, coin and stamp catalogues, and watch-collection trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=watch:item
| search insured_value=*
| stats sum(insured_value) as insured_value count as watches by brand
| sort 0 - insured_value
description: Ranks brandss by watch collection value concentration.
value: Value concentration shows whether the risk and attention of the collection is dominated by one brand or line.
implementation: Send watch collection value concentration events to `index=personal` and keep `brand` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of watch collection value concentration by brands.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps which brandss stand out most for watch collection value concentration.
